peer_identity.arc_label: The Father-Mother Metabaron—from Steelhead's daughter to self-conceiving No-Name's parent
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Bald, female-bodied, carries male twin's brain (transplanted by Steelhead). Raised and presented as male heir. Possesses bionic left hand from initiation rite; psycho-mimetic aura; invisibility cloak. Shed first tear only at Deyanira's death. Radically self-sufficient—fights alone, refuses fleet command. Performed first auto-conception in history via hypo-genetics from own brain tissue. Grieves that she can only destroy, not create, before choosing to have No-Name. Designated him 'No-Name' and 'father-mother.'
peer_identity.rationale: All three records describe the same person at continuous life stages: vol15 shows childhood through defeating Steelhead; vol16 shows prime Metabaron, self-conceiving No-Name, departing to give birth; vol17 shows her pregnant and giving birth on Flos. The voice and traits are consistent throughout: resolute, mission-focused, duty-driven, despises humanity, governed by Bushitaka warrior doctrine. No contradictory facts.
